transports.note: Persisted queries addressed by SHA-256 hash. The hashes rotate server-side — downstream projects report 24-72h to catch up when one changes — so a hash in code is a moving part, not a constant.
Three distinct sockets, not one. The chat socket tunnels IRC — a text protocol inside the frames — so a reader expecting JSON concludes the socket carries nothing useful.
transports.encoding: The hermes socket carries an encrypted envelope; the IRC socket carries text, not JSON. Encoding is a property of each socket, so neither is a separate transport row.

transports.note: Playlist needs an access token minted by a GraphQL call first. The player also fetches and parses the playlist inside a Web Worker — ad-blocking projects hook exactly that worker — so a page-scoped capture sees no media at all on a streaming page.
transports.evidence: Measured by driving the browser here on 2026-07-29. Verified to media: playlist -> variant -> a fetched MP4 segment.
